sentences.en: How long have you been alienated from your family?
sentences.zh: 你和家人疏远有多久了？

sentences.en: With that attitude, you will alienate all of your potential allies.
sentences.zh: 如果你态度不变，你会让所有潜在盟友对你失去好感。

sentences.en: Yanni was attempting to alienate Skura from her friends.
sentences.zh: 亚尼试图让斯库拉远离她的朋友。
